test_data_leakage: NONE. TRF TEST was unsealed exactly once after the model was completely fit and frozen.
saraga_leakage: NONE. SARAGA was used only for evaluation.
platt_scaling_calibration: Platt scaling (`probability=True` in sklearn.svm.SVC) is fitted using an internal 5-fold cross-validation on the provided training data ONLY. Since the training data provided to `fit()` was strictly TRF TRAIN, the calibration is mathematically isolated and uncontaminated by TRF TEST or FOLK.
